related_questions.question: Can COVID stay on dog fur?
related_questions.snippet: Q: Can my pet contract COVID-19? Yes, but it's very rare. Pet hair is porous, and it tends to trap viruses in it. So, it's very difficult to spread a virus on the hair coat of a dog or a cat, unlike the smooth surface of a doorknob or a countertop.
